verdict.rationale: A corporate registry with online filing could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The probe found that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The only permission-related evidence covers human roles (full access manager, filing collaborator, corporation key) for the Online Filing Centre, which is an adjacent feature, not agent API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
